samples.xml_description:
<module id="freq_divbyodd">
    <description>A frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency by odd numbers. The module generates a divided clock output by an odd divisor value provided as a parameter.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal that initializes the divider.</input>
        <output id="clk_div">Divided clock output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="NUM_DIV" type="integer">Odd divisor value for frequency division.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <implementation>
        // Initialize counters and clock divider outputs
        integer cnt1 = 0;
        integer cnt2 = 0;
        reg clk_div1 = 0;
        reg clk_div2 = 0;
        
        // Positive edge clock divider
        if(cnt1 == ((NUM_DIV/2)-1)) begin
            clk_div1 <= ~clk_div1;
            cnt1 <= 0;
        end else begin
            cnt1 <= cnt1 + 1;
        end
        
        // Negative edge clock divider
        if(cnt2 == ((NUM_DIV/2)-1)) begin
            clk_div2 <= ~clk_div2;
            cnt2 <= 0;
        end else begin
            cnt2 <= cnt2 + 1;
        end
        
        // Final divided clock output
        assign clk_div = clk_div1 | clk_div2;
    </implementation>
</module>
